Read from the engine’s own per-request timers, so every request counts: streaming or not, through this server’s port or straight to vLLM’s. Each figure is tokens over the time the engine spent in that phase, across recent requests — the speed one request sees, not the combined throughput of several at once. These are not the numbers in vLLM’s log, which divide by the logging interval and read zero whenever no prompt arrived in it.
